svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IfGOxTrTSR-4EnEHe-hC"> <mxGraphModel dx="4970" dy="2248" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 User[\"User\"] --> Frontend[\"React + TypeScript<br/>Vite Web App\"]
 Frontend --> Gateway[\"Spring Cloud API Gateway<br/>HTTPS, CORS, Rate Limiting\"]

 Gateway --> Auth[\"Auth Service<br/>Spring Boot + Spring Security + JWT\"]
 Gateway --> Media[\"Media Service<br/>Spring Boot + JPA\"]
 Gateway --> Health[\"Health Endpoints<br/>Actuator\"]

 Auth --> UserDB[(\"Users Database<br/>MySQL/PostgreSQL\")]
 Media --> MediaDB[(\"Media Database<br/>Metadata + Results\")]
 Media --> MinIO[(\"MinIO / S3<br/>Secure Media Storage\")]
 Media --> ML[\"Python ML Service<br/>FastAPI\"]
 Media --> Queue[\"RabbitMQ/Kafka<br/>Optional Async Jobs\"]

 ML --> Validate[\"Validate Input\"]
 Validate --> Face[\"Face Detection and Crop<br/>OpenCV / MediaPipe\"]
 Face --> Preprocess[\"Resize and Normalize\"]
 Preprocess --> Model[\"Pre-trained Deepfake Detector<br/>Xception / EfficientNet\"]
 Model --> Prediction[\"Real/Fake Classification<br/>Confidence Score\"]
 Prediction --> MLResponse[\"ML Response<br/>Model, Confidence, Processing Time\"]
 MLResponse --> Media

 Media --> Results[\"Save Detection Result<br/>Timestamp and Metadata\"]
 Results --> MediaDB
 Media --> Frontend

 subgraph MVP[\"Image Detection MVP\"]
 Upload[\"Image Upload\"] --> FileValidation[\"File Type, Size and Filename Validation\"]
 FileValidation --> SecureStorage[\"Store File in MinIO\"]
 SecureStorage --> ImageAnalysis[\"Synchronous Image Analysis\"]
 ImageAnalysis --> Result[\"Return Real/Fake Result\"]
 end

 Media -.-> Upload
 ImageAnalysis -.-> ML

 subgraph FrontendPages[\"Frontend Pages\"]
 Home[\"Home / Dashboard\"]
 UploadPage[\"Upload Page<br/>Drag and Drop + Progress\"]
 ResultPage[\"Results Page<br/>Preview, Outcome, Confidence\"]
 HistoryPage[\"History Page<br/>Optional MVP\"]
 end

 Frontend --> Home
 Frontend --> UploadPage
 Frontend --> ResultPage
 Frontend --> HistoryPage

 subgraph Security[\"Security Controls\"]
 JWT[\"JWT Authentication\"]
 Restrictions[\"File Size and MIME Restrictions\"]
 Paths[\"Path Traversal Protection\"]
 Secrets[\"Environment Variables\"]
 TLS[\"HTTPS Deployment\"]
 Hardening[\"Container Hardening\"]
 end

 Auth --> JWT
 Media --> Restrictions
 Media --> Paths
 Gateway --> TLS
 Gateway --> Hardening
 Secrets -.-> Auth
 Secrets -.-> Media
 Secrets -.-> MinIO
 Secrets -.-> ML

 subgraph VideoStretch[\"Video Detection Stretch\"]
 VideoUpload[\"Video Upload\"] --> Frames[\"FFmpeg/OpenCV Frame Sampling\"]
 Frames --> FrameFaces[\"Face Detection per Frame\"]
 FrameFaces --> FrameModel[\"Frame-Level Predictions\"]
 FrameModel --> Aggregate[\"Aggregate Video Result\"]
 Aggregate --> VideoProgress[\"Optional WebSocket Progress\"]
 end

 Media -.-> VideoUpload
 Queue -.-> Frames
 ML -.-> FrameModel

 subgraph Deployment[\"Docker Compose Deployment\"]
 FrontendContainer[\"frontend\"]
 GatewayContainer[\"gateway\"]
 AuthContainer[\"auth-service\"]
 MediaContainer[\"media-service\"]
 MLContainer[\"ml-service\"]
 DatabaseContainer[\"database\"]
 MinIOContainer[\"minio\"]
 end

 FrontendContainer --> GatewayContainer
 GatewayContainer --> AuthContainer
 GatewayContainer --> MediaContainer
 AuthContainer --> DatabaseContainer
 MediaContainer --> DatabaseContainer
 MediaContainer --> MinIOContainer
 MediaContainer --> MLContainer

 subgraph Testing[\"Testing and Evaluation\"]
 BackendTests[\"JUnit, Mockito, MockMvc<br/>Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers\"]
 MLTests[\"pytest\"]
 FrontendTests[\"Vitest / Jest<br/>React Testing Library\"]
 Integration[\"Integration Flow<br/>Upload → Storage → ML → Database → Result\"]
 Metrics[\"Accuracy, Precision, Recall<br/>F1, ROC-AUC, Latency\"]
 end

 BackendTests -.-> Auth
 BackendTests -.-> Media
 MLTests -.-> ML
 FrontendTests -.-> Frontend
 Integration -.-> Media
 Metrics -.-> Model


 class Frontend,Home,UploadPage,ResultPage,HistoryPage frontend
 class Gateway,Auth,Media,Health backend
 class ML,Validate,Face,Preprocess,Model,Prediction,MLResponse ml
 class UserDB,MediaDB,MinIO storage
 class Queue,VideoUpload,Frames,FrameFaces,FrameModel,Aggregate,VideoProgress optional
 class JWT,Restrictions,Paths,Secrets,TLS,Hardening security",
 "config": null
